profile.headline: Software Engineer at MGIC
profile.summary:
Backend Software Engineer with extensive experience designing and deploying secure, scalable architectures across hybrid cloud environments. I have delivered mission-critical solutions for industry leaders including MGIC, Equifax, Cognizant, Prudential, and Sicom Systems, ranging from mortgage insurance calculators and sanctions screening applications to fiscal printer drivers.

My technical expertise centers on Java (8–17), Kotlin, Spring Boot, and Angular, supported by robust infrastructure skills in Terraform, AWS, and GCP. I specialize in modernizing workflows through CI/CD pipeline development (Jenkins, GitLab), implementing JWT authentication, and automating infrastructure via CloudFormation. I am driven by transforming complex technical requirements into practical, high-performance software solutions.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Architected a full-stack mortgage insurance application using Angular Typescript for the frontend and Java Spring Boot for backend services to
process customer data and calculate insurance premiums.
● Implemented secure authentication protocols using JWT Tokens, ensuring endpoints met strict partner security documentation and header signature
requirements.
● Orchestrated containerized deployments by developing Kubernetes configuration files and automating releases via GitLab CI/CD pipelines.
● Collaborated directly with stakeholders to define field requirements, resolve critical bugs, and deliver feature enhancements for on-premise Java
applications.
positions.insights: Skills: Angular 8 · Angular Material · Angular CLI · Java · Spring Boot · Spring Framework · REST APIs · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Amazon Dynamodb · Karma · Terraform · DevOps · Software Infrastructure · Java Development · Software Design · Tomcat · Jira · Kubernetes · Docker · JSON Web Token (JWT)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Led the migration to GCP ecosystem and the development of scalable data collection features, utilizing Kotlin and Spring Boot frameworks.
● Engineered cloud infrastructure on GCP and AWS, utilizing Terraform and CloudFormation for reproducible Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
● Maintained and added features to legacy Java 8-17 applications backed by Oracle and Postgres databases.
● Designed and optimized CI/CD workflows using Jenkins, significantly reducing deployment times and manual errors.

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description:
Developed critical features for Sanctions screening applications, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards (Fircosoft).
● Developed and enhanced features for Fraud screening applications (Actimize).
● Wrote applications to capture metrics from the screening application and create alerts for internal users and project managers.
● Automated infrastructure provisioning and application deployment using Ansible scripts and GitLab CI/CD workflows.
● Built robust data ingestion pipelines using the AWS S3 library to parse Bacs/ACH payments and feed downstream vendor applications.
● Designed and maintained RESTful API endpoints, facilitating seamless integration between internal services and vendor tools.

positions.title: Analyst, Systems Developer
positions.description:
● Engineered a Supplier Intake Application using the Angular 8 framework, streamlining the review and approval process for the Accounts Payable
team.
● Spearheaded the migration of version control systems from PVCS to GitLab, presenting the transition plan and training the team on best practices.
● Developed a custom Jenkins plugin to trigger automated SonarQube scans, improving code quality and maintainability.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Engineered cross-platform communication services using .NET and XML, enabling seamless data exchange between international Point of Sale (POS) systems and the proprietary OCU.
Developed fiscal printer drivers for the Venezuelan and Polish markets using C and C# .NET, ensuring local regulatory compliance.
Modernized legacy code by converting Colombian fiscal reporting drivers from C to C#, improving maintainability and performance.
Authored comprehensive technical installation documentation for the OCU Service to streamline deployment for field technicians.
Consulted on architectural design shifts to migrate the core C codebase to a C# Mono framework for enhanced cross-platform compatibility.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Managed a large-scale version control migration from SVN to Git, preserving codebase integrity and history.
Established and presented standardized Git branching workflows to the engineering team to improve collaborative development cycles.
Standardized technical documentation by authoring detailed compilation instructions for various internal programming languages.
